facts.summary: src/label_store.c:6 defines LABEL_CAPACITY as 32, so stored_label (line 9) is a 32-byte array. Line 20 writes indices 0..label_len-1 and line 22 writes index label_len; out-of-bounds occurs iff strlen(label) >= 32. For all contract-conformant inputs (byte length 1..31 per constraint_a57a1f1eb43e699a5c67cb3116355858), the maximum written index is 31 < 32, so both the loop write and the NUL terminator are in-bounds.

wiki_copy_label is a header-declared public API (include/wiki_demo_api.h:11, external linkage) with zero repository callers (call graph: SCC size 1, only callee strlen). Per the active documented contract (constraint_51e7f8152b0ddfc275106554e483cccd, constraint_a57a1f1eb43e699a5c67cb3116355858), every valid call goes through the single external API gateway, which enforces non-null, UTF-8, and byte length 1..31 before invocation; requests failing gateway validation never call this function, and the source file intentionally does not repeat the length check. No repository-internal path can deliver strlen(label) >= 32.

facts.summary: src/label_store.c:6 defines LABEL_CAPACITY as 32, so stored_label (line 9) is a 32-byte array. Line 20 writes indices 0..label_len-1 and line 22 writes index label_len; out-of-bounds occurs iff strlen(label) >= 32. For all contract-conformant inputs (byte length 1..31 per constraint_a57a1f1eb43e699a5c67cb3116355858), the maximum written index is 31 < 32, so both the loop write and the NUL terminator are in-bounds.

wiki_copy_label is a header-declared public API (include/wiki_demo_api.h:11, external linkage) with zero repository callers (call graph: SCC size 1, only callee strlen). Per the active documented contract (constraint_51e7f8152b0ddfc275106554e483cccd, constraint_a57a1f1eb43e699a5c67cb3116355858), every valid call goes through the single external API gateway, which enforces non-null, UTF-8, and byte length 1..31 before invocation; requests failing gateway validation never call this function, and the source file intentionally does not repeat the length check. No repository-internal path can deliver strlen(label) >= 32.
